divisions.title: Courtship and Longing
divisions.summary: The beloved and her lover meet, exchange praises, and she searches for him through the night streets.

divisions.title: The Wedding
divisions.summary: The bridegroom praises his bride, the garden is entered, and love is celebrated in full covenant commitment.

divisions.title: Mature Love
divisions.summary: The lovers grow in mutual admiration and devotion, culminating in the seal of unbreakable love.
